lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits; centroid spacing increases and cluster diameter expands moving posteriorly from the cranial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary spot columns, creating a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light-intensity pixels on the superior edge to shadow-intensity pixels on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two high-luminance, elongated biological features (commensal organisms) are visible attached to the lower mid-flank and the proximal region of the pectoral fin.
